questions.q: What do you usually do at the weekend?
questions.answer: I try to keep weekends flexible after a busy week. Usually I catch up on sleep, meet a friend or two, and maybe run some errands. If I'm lucky, I'll fit in a book or a film to properly [[recharge]].

questions.q: Who do you usually spend your weekends with?
questions.answer: Mostly with my family, to be honest. My younger sister and I sometimes go out for snacks, and occasionally we all visit my grandparents in the village. Evenings are usually for friends, so my weekends feel pleasantly [[well-rounded]].

questions.q: Do you prefer weekdays or weekends?
questions.answer: Weekends, without question. Weekdays are productive but tiring, whereas weekends give me space to rest and see people. That balance is what keeps me [[going]] through the week.

questions.q: Did you do anything special last weekend?
questions.answer: Nothing extraordinary. On Friday I went to the mosque for Friday prayers, then spent the afternoon reading. On Saturday I met two old friends for tea, and we ended up chatting for hours, which was [[thoroughly]] enjoyable.

questions.q: Are your weekends different now from when you were a child?
questions.answer: Completely. As a child, weekends meant endless cricket and visits to relatives. Now they're mostly about resting and catching up on things I couldn't do during the week, so they feel less [[adventurous]] but more precious.
